instruction: In paper_reading_2024_03_01.docx, find the Arxiv PDF link of the second paper and open that link in Chrome.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active Chrome tab URL from the accessibility tree, which is the exact state needed to verify that the Arxiv PDF link was opened in Chrome.
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly handles the type='rule' expected parameter: it receives the rules dict directly and accesses rules['expected'] to get the list of regex patterns.

The regex pattern 'arxiv\.org.*2402\.19155' correctly matches the second paper's Arxiv URL (https://arxiv.org/pdf/2402.19155.pdf), as confirmed by the metadata stating the document contains 'Arxiv PDF: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2402.19155.pdf'.
The evaluator provides full coverage: opening the link in Chrome implicitly requires finding it first, and verifying the active tab URL checks both requirements.
Negative-control resistance is adequate: the initial Chrome state shows huggingface.co, which would not match the arxiv.org regex pattern.
